result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major loading-state overlay on a restaurant card and a minor loading spinner that looks unfinished.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image is covered by a large circular spinner, so the photo is obscured and it is unclear whether the card is still loading or stuck.
issues.suggestion: Show a skeleton or shimmer on the image until it is ready, then hide the spinner. If loading fails, show an error or retry state instead of leaving the overlay visible.

issues.description: The spinner is a mostly empty white circle with only a small green arc, which looks incomplete and draws attention away from the restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer, more complete loading indicator that is smaller or placed so it does not dominate the card image.
